title: Be BOLD this week.
html:
BOLD: Not hesitating or being fearful, in the face of danger or rebuke.

It’s a fact that when you are bold, spontaneous, daring, and take calculated risks, life and circumstances will move towards you and help with what you are attempting to achieve.

Being bold does not mean you have to be sassy or brazen, it means you use your natural strengths and talents, combined with confidence and motivation to be your best.

Make the first move: be courageous, think outside the box, and take action.

Be BOLD this week. You will surprise yourself, and those around you, with the amazing things you can achieve.

Glenn 'ctrl+b' Edley
